name: baseline-research-workflows
description: Interactive loopback literature research workflow for Codex with optional repository cloning.

interface.shortDescription: Run an interactive literature research workflow.
interface.longDescription: Installs repo-local Codex custom agent templates for an iterative literature research workflow with requirement collection, scope locking, paper discovery, code verification, optional local repository cloning, CSV output, and reviewer-driven loopback.
defaultPrompt: Use my paper as a seed for literature research.
Research papers and clone verified code repositories.
